style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
title: ¡Un helado GIGANTE de colores! 🍦🐘 | Aprende los colores con Tito #Shorts
room: A sunny tropical beach, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: soft golden sand, gentle turquoise sea and small waves in the background, two palm trees, a striped beach umbrella, clear blue sky with fluffy clouds. On the sand stands a GIANT ice cream cone, taller than a child, with three huge scoops stacked: a red strawberry scoop at the bottom, a yellow banana scoop in the middle and a brown chocolate scoop on top. The scoops are plain smooth ice cream, like real ice cream in a shop. Nobody is on the beach.
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¡Un helado gigante!
[Verse]
Bola roja, ¡fresa!
Bola amarilla, ¡plátano!
Bola café, ¡chocolate!
[Chorus]
Helado de colores, ¡mmm, qué rico!
[Outro]
¡Uno, dos, tres! ¡Mmm!
shots: H1
Low angle medium shot: the baby elephant stands next to the giant ice cream cone on the beach that towers over him, he looks up at it with a huge surprised open-mouth smile, ears raised.
The baby elephant looks up at the giant ice cream, his ears lift in surprise and his eyes sparkle. Static camera.
H2
Medium close-up: the baby elephant points his trunk at the huge red strawberry scoop of the giant ice cream, happy face.
The baby elephant points at the red scoop with his trunk and nods happily. Static camera.
H3
Medium shot: the baby elephant stands beside the same giant three-scoop ice cream cone and looks up at its huge yellow banana middle scoop, delighted smile.
The baby elephant looks at the yellow scoop and smiles, his ears flap gently. Static camera.
H4
Medium shot: the baby elephant stands beside the giant three-scoop ice cream cone, which is taller than him, and stretches his trunk up toward the brown chocolate scoop on the very top, eyes wide.
The baby elephant stretches his trunk up toward the brown scoop and giggles. Static camera.
H5
Medium shot: the baby elephant hugs himself with joy on the beach in front of the giant ice cream, eyes closed, blissful 'mmm' smile.
The baby elephant sways happily side to side with his eyes closed, smiling. Static camera.
H6
Wide shot: the baby elephant dances on the sand next to the giant three-color ice cream cone, ears flapping, one foot raised.
The baby elephant dances gently side to side next to the giant ice cream. Static camera.
H7
Medium close-up: the baby elephant has a small dab of pink strawberry ice cream on the tip of his trunk, he looks at it cross-eyed and laughs.
The baby elephant looks at the ice cream on his trunk and laughs. Static camera.
